words.zh: n. 宇航员，太空人
words.example: The astronaut trained for years before going into space.

words.zh: n. 步骤；程序；手续；手术；【财】（清算）程序；【计】过程；【化】步骤
words.example: Please follow the safety procedure before starting the experiment.

words.zh: adj. 精神的；思想的；脑力的；心理的；内心的；精神病治疗的；  n. 意念（一种游戏角色属性）
words.example: Regular exercise can improve both physical and mental health.

words.zh: abbr. =(centimeter)厘米
words.example: The insect was only two cm long, almost invisible.

words.zh: adj. 有智慧的，聪明的；智能的
words.example: Dolphins are intelligent animals that communicate with each other.

words.zh: n. 火箭，火箭弹；芝麻菜；  vt. 用火箭运载；  vi. 飞快地移动；猛涨
words.example: The rocket lifted off smoothly from the launch pad.

words.zh: n. 重力，引力；严重性；庄重，严肃
words.example: Astronauts learn to work in conditions of low gravity.

words.zh: n. 边境，国界；边远地区，边界地区；新领域；知识/物理学等的前沿；  adj. 开拓的
words.example: Exploring deep space is the new frontier of science.

words.zh: n. 车辆；交通工具；传播媒介；工具，手段
words.example: The Mars rover is a vehicle designed for exploring another planet.

words.zh: adj. 有决心的；意志坚定的；决定了的
words.example: She was determined to finish the race despite the heavy rain.

words.zh: v. 做决定；查明；确定，测定；决定，支配；下决心；【化】确定，测定；【数】准确算出
words.example: Scientists use different methods to determine the age of rocks.

words.zh: n. 卫星；人造卫星；随体；【物】人造卫星；  adj. 卫视的
words.example: The satellite sends images of Earth back to scientists.

words.zh: v. 发射；下水；创办，开始从事；发起，实施；上市，发行；推出；  n. 发射，投放市场；（游艇、汽艇）下水；发行；汽艇
words.example: They plan to launch the new satellite next Monday morning.

words.zh: vi. 盘旋；绕轨道运行；  vt. 沿轨道运行，环绕……运行；  n. 轨道；势力范围；眼眶；生活常规；【物】轨道
words.example: The Moon takes about twenty-seven days to orbit Earth.

words.zh: adj. 巨大的，特大的；伟大的；  n. 巨人；伟人；庞然大物；大公司
words.example: A giant telescope helps us see distant stars clearly.

words.zh: v. 跳跃，跃过；暴涨；踊跃；飞跃，跃进；  n. 跳跃；跳动；剧增，剧变
words.example: That discovery was a great leap forward in medical science.

words.zh: n. 人类；男人
words.example: The invention of the wheel changed the history of mankind.

words.zh: n. 代理机构；中介；地区政府；服务机构；作用；代理处；行政部门；【法】代理
words.example: The space agency announced a new mission to Mars.

words.zh: v. 传播；发送；发射；传输；传送，输送；【航】传输
words.example: Radios transmit signals to receivers over long distances.

words.zh: n. 数据；资料；【计】数据；【化】数据；【数】数据
words.example: We collected data from the experiment and analyzed it carefully.

words.zh: phr. 在船上；在飞机上；在宇宙飞船上
words.example: There are six astronauts on board the International Space Station.

words.zh: n. 宇宙飞船；航天器
words.example: The spacecraft returned safely after its long mission.

words.zh: n. 沮丧；失望；扫兴
words.example: To her disappointment, the concert was cancelled due to rain.

words.zh: adj. 失望的，沮丧的
words.example: He felt disappointed when he missed the winning goal.

words.zh: n. 渴望；欲望；愿望；要求；情欲；  vi. 有希望，期望，愿望；  vt. 希望，渴望；请求，要求
words.example: Her strong desire to learn drove her to study every night.

words.zh: n. 宇宙，天地万物；领域，范围
words.example: Scientists believe the universe is expanding all the time.

words.zh: phr. 继续，坚持；继续开展，继续下去
words.example: We must carry on exploring even after difficulties arise.

words.zh: adv. 独立地；自立地
words.example: She learned to solve the problem independently without any help.

words.zh: adj. 独立的，自立的；无偏见的；  n. 无党派者
words.example: After college, he became financially independent of his parents.

words.zh: n. 太空行走；太空行走的时间
words.example: The astronauts performed a spacewalk to repair the station.

words.zh: n. 玉石；翡翠；玉制品；  adj. 玉制的，玉的；翡翠色；绿玉色的，翡翠色的；  v. 使疲倦不堪
words.example: The ancient necklace was made of polished green jade.

words.zh: n. 组件，模件，（航天器的）舱；（组成一门课程的）独立单元；【计】功能块，程序块；【财】模块；【计】模块
words.example: The lunar module separated from the command module before landing on the Moon.

words.zh: v. 发信号；标志；预示；表明；  n. 信号；标志；预兆；导火线；动机；【电】信号；  adj. 显著的，优越的；暗号的，作信号用的
words.example: Astronauts use radio signals to communicate with mission control on Earth.

words.en: in the hope of doing sth
words.zh: phr. 抱着……的希望；希望
words.example: Scientists study Mars in the hope of finding signs of ancient life.

words.zh: phr. 为了，以便
words.example: The spacecraft was launched early so as to reach the station before sunset.

words.zh: v. 回收利用；改建；【航】回收利用；  n. 再循环
words.example: Astronauts recycle wastewater on the space station to save precious resources.

words.zh: v. 用强硬手段获得；  n. 肌肉；实力，影响力；体力；肌；【医】肌；【生】肌肉
words.example: Daily exercise helps astronauts prevent muscle loss during long space missions.

words.zh: n. 缺乏，短缺；不足；  v. 没有；缺乏
words.example: A lack of gravity can cause serious health problems for astronauts in space.

words.zh: v. 使浮动，使漂浮；飘动，漂移；发行股票上市；【物】漂浮；  vi. 浮动，漂流，漂浮；散布；漂泊；飘浮；  n. 浮标，漂浮物，漂浮
words.example: In microgravity, astronauts can float freely inside the space station cabin.

words.zh: adv. 否则；要不然；除此之外；在其他方面，另，亦；【法】除此之外；  conj. 否则，不然
words.example: You must check your oxygen supply regularly; otherwise, you may be in danger.

words.zh: prep. 超出；在更远处；无法……；除…之外；晚于，迟于；在（或向）......较远的一边；  adv. 超出；在更远处，在另一边
words.example: The view of Earth from beyond the atmosphere is truly breathtaking.

words.zh: adj. 太阳能的；太阳系的；日光的；太阳的；  n. 日光浴室
words.example: Solar panels provide clean energy for the space station's daily operations.

words.zh: phr. 太阳系；类太阳系
words.example: Our solar system consists of eight planets and many other smaller objects.

words.zh: adj. 当前的，现在的；流动的；  n. 水流；电流；思潮
words.example: The current mission aims to study the effects of long-term space travel.

words.zh: phr. 想出，弄明白；解决
words.example: Engineers are trying to figure out why the spacecraft's engine failed.

words.zh: adj. 足够的，充足的；充分的；【化】足够的
words.example: The rocket must carry sufficient fuel to reach the distant planet safely.

words.zh: n. 肥皂；  v. 用肥皂擦洗
words.example: Astronauts use special liquid soap to wash their hands in space.

words.zh: n. 毛巾，手巾；抹布；  v. 用毛巾擦干
words.example: Each astronaut receives a clean towel and personal hygiene kit every day.

words.zh: n. 望远镜；  v. 叠缩；缩短，精简；（使）套入；压缩；  adj. 套筒的，伸缩式的
words.example: The new telescope allows scientists to observe galaxies far beyond our own.

words.zh: v. 用微波炉加热；  n. 微波炉，微波；【物】微波
words.example: Astronauts use a microwave oven to heat their packaged meals on the station.

words.zh: n. 纸巾；（人、动植物细胞的）组织；纱布；【生】组织
words.example: Scientists study how zero gravity affects human muscle tissue and bone density.

words.zh: n. 设施，设备；灵巧；才能，资质；容易；（供特定用途的）场所
words.example: The space training facility includes a huge swimming pool for weightlessness practice.

words.zh: adj. 敏锐的；热衷的，渴望的；强烈的；着迷的；喜爱，有兴趣；  v. 恸哭
words.example: She has been keen on astronomy since she first saw the stars through a telescope.

words.zh: n. 球体，地球仪；地球，世界；  v. （使）成球状
words.example: The astronauts took photographs of the globe from the space station window.

words.zh: v. 争论；论证，争辩；主张，认为；提供证据，证明；表明（原因等）；提出异议；争吵
words.example: Some scientists argue that humans should colonize Mars in the near future.

words.zh: n. 争吵，争论，争辩；辩论；论据，论点；【计】参数
words.example: There is a strong argument for investing more money in space exploration.

words.zh: adj. 致命的；灾难性的，毁灭性的；决定性的
words.example: A tiny leak in the spacesuit could be fatal to an astronaut during a spacewalk.

words.zh: adj. 浅的；肤浅的；浅显易懂的；  v. 变浅；使变浅；  n. 浅滩；浅处
words.example: The rover stopped near a shallow crater to collect rock samples for analysis.

words.zh: phr. 导致，造成
words.example: Poor planning can result in mission failure and the loss of valuable equipment.

words.zh: v. 形成图案；促成（某种行为模式）；  n. 模型，模式；典范；图案；版式；样品；花样；方式；【计】模式；【化】模式；【物】斑图；【数】规律
words.example: Scientists noticed a strange pattern in the radio signals from the distant planet.

words.zh: n. 分析；分解；分析报告；精神分析；【化】分析
words.example: Chemical analysis of the soil samples may reveal whether life once existed on Mars.

words.zh: phr. 所以，结果是；因此
words.example: The satellite lost power; as a result, it stopped sending data to Earth.

words.zh: adj. 高端的
words.example: The laboratory uses high-end equipment to build and test small satellites.

words.zh: v. 监视；监督；监测；监控；【化】监控，监测；【航】监控；  n. 显示器；监视器；监测仪；班长；监控；监听；课代表
words.example: Doctors monitor the astronauts' heart rate and blood pressure during space missions.

words.zh: adv. 经常，定期地；有规律地；正常地；【化】定期地
words.example: Astronauts exercise regularly to keep their bodies strong in zero gravity.

words.zh: adj. 定期的，有规律的；经常的；正常的；匀称的；普通的，常规的；左脚前（习惯为左脚在前的滑板姿势）；通常的，平常的；  n. 常客；正式队员
words.example: The station receives regular supply shipments from Earth every few months.

words.zh: n. 泡沫；泡沫体；泡沫橡胶；汗沫，唾沫；  vi. 吐白沫，起泡沫
words.example: Memory foam pillows help astronauts sleep comfortably in the space station.

words.zh: n. 枕头；  v. 垫，枕着
words.example: The astronaut strapped her pillow to the wall to keep it from floating away.

words.zh: n. 智能手机
words.example: Astronauts use a smartphone to take photos and record videos on the space station.

words.zh: v. 向…提供资金（或设备）；  n. 资源；资料；财力；物力；办法；谋略；【化】资源
words.example: Water is the most precious resource for astronauts on a long space mission.

words.zh: adj. 有限的；被限制的
words.example: The spacecraft has limited space, so every piece of equipment must be carefully chosen.

words.zh: phr. 提供生活所需
words.example: After the spaceship was damaged, the crew had to provide for themselves for several days.

words.zh: adj. 结束的；  v. 动词close的现在分词.；  n. 关闭；终止；结算；地产成交会；【法】交割，完成交易
words.example: The closing ceremony of the school science festival will be held tomorrow evening.

words.zh: adj. 结束的；  v. 动词close的现在分词.；  n. 关闭；终止；结算；地产成交会；【法】交割，完成交易
words.example: In closing, the astronaut thanked everyone who had supported the space mission.

words.zh: n. 神秘（感）；神秘的事物；难以解决的事情；难以理解的事物；疑案故事
words.example: One mystery of the universe is whether life exists beyond Earth.

words.zh: phr. 用完，耗尽
words.example: Our oxygen supply might run out before the rescue team arrives.

words.zh: v. 贴上，使依附；把……固定，把……附（在……上）；认为...有重要性；附加；缚；赋予；【化】结合，附着；【航】使依附，贴上
words.example: The engineer will attach the new module to the space station.

words.zh: n. 氧气，氧；【物】氧气
words.example: Astronauts need oxygen to survive in the vacuum of space.

words.zh: abbr. 美国国家航空和航天管理局(=National Aeronautics and Space Administration)
words.example: NASA plans to send another rover to explore the surface of Mars.

words.zh: n. 火星；【物】火星
words.example: Scientists have found evidence that water once flowed on Mars.

words.zh: n. 木星；【物】木星
words.example: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system and has many moons.
